summary: Expanded the underfollowed universe for tier 2 / tier 3 defense subcontractors, focusing on public small/mid-cap suppliers where visibility, qualification history, customer concentration, defense backlog, and compliance burden may matter more than headline prime-contractor exposure. The strongest discovery lane candidates are niche aerospace/defense electronics, structural assemblies, specialty subsystems, and advanced materials suppliers. General node evidence supports the premise that DoD and primes often lose visibility below tier 2, while tariff and exemption paperwork can be disproportionately burdensome for smaller suppliers.
